text:
Maya (Design): quick check — for the new Dashboard > Project Settings form, i'm leaning toward inline errors + a small top summary toast for multi-field failures. thoughts? :thinking:
Alex (PM): inline makes sense for fast fixes. summary toast helps when multiple fields fail on save so users don't miss anything. agree on both, but i worry about redundancy.
Tariq (Eng): from an implementation POV inline + a single compact top summary is cheap. we can auto-focus the first invalid field. do we want aria-live for summary?
Sam (Accessibility): yes aria-live region for the summary (role="status", polite) plus ensure each inline error is announced when the field loses focus or on submit. also need to move focus to the summary when keyboard users hit submit and there are multiple errors.
Maya (Design): good call. microcopy options: 1) Inline: "Please enter a valid URL" + required marker as * 2) Inline: "Required" label after the field 3) Inline with helper copy (short). which is clearest?
Jordan (DesignOps): prefer explicit "Required" for keyboards and localization clarity. asterisk alone is too subtle for some languages and for some screen reader setups.
Alex (PM): product-wise we prefer minimal visual noise. asterisk handles most power users, but agree we should show explicit "Required" for required + error state. maybe only show the word in collapsed/mobile?
Tariq (Eng): implementation note: toggling visible "Required" adds DOM churn for every required field. we can render aria-required=true and visually hide the word for sighted users while exposing it to screen readers if needed.
Sam (Accessibility): aria-required alone isn't great for discovery. recommend visible "Required" text for long forms where people might scan. for compact forms (two fields) asterisks are okay if we include a legend and ensure screen readers get the info.
Maya (Design): compromise proposal: always show a legend at top "Fields marked * are required" + show visible "Required" inline only when field is focused or after failed submit. keeps UI clean while surfacing info when needed.
Alex (PM): sounds reasonable. can we get a quick mock?
Maya (Design): i'll post mocks in #design-assets by EOD.
Tariq (Eng): on destructive actions — delete project flow. current copy: "Delete project permanently?" + big red button. we need typed-confirm?
Jordan (DesignOps): for org-level deletes yes typed-confirmting should be required. for local-test projects maybe a single modal with undo is enough. can we differentiate by risk-level?
Sam (Accessibility): typed confirm is accessible if implemented well: focus on input, label, and instructions. we should avoid relying on color alone for severity. ensure keyboard users can cancel quickly.
Maya (Design): copy options for typed confirm: A) "Type DELETE to confirm permanent removal of this project." B) "To confirm, type the project name: example-project". pros/cons?
Alex (PM): typing the project name is safer (prevents accidental muscle-memory deletes) but more friction. for org-facing projects use name; for personal/test use "DELETE".
Tariq (Eng): tech note: typed-confirm should be checked case-insensitively and trimmed. also debounce paste? we can allow paste but log it for audit.
Jordan (DesignOps): +1 to logging paste for audit. also show a short one-line consequence summary: "This will permanently delete data X, Y; you will lose access" before the confirm.
Maya (Design): accessibility nit — announce the modal with role=dialog and set aria-modal=true, trap focus, and ensure escape closes it. We also need clear focusable cancel/confirm buttons.
Sam (Accessibility): add: when modal opens, move focus to the heading, then to the text field (if typed confirm) so screen readers read context first. ensure error messages for typed-confirm are announced with aria-live="assertive".
Tariq (Eng): implementing: we can use an existing Dialog component. will add a typed-confirm input variant and a11y options. estimate 2 days to implement and test across browsers + NVDA/VoiceOver.
Maya (Design): final decision checklist?
Alex (PM): - Inline errors + top compact summary (aria-live) — agree
Alex (PM): - Required marker: legend + asterisk by default, show "Required" on focus/failed submit — agree
Alex (PM): - Delete flow: risk-tiered approach, typed-confirm for org-level, project-name for high-risk, log paste — agree
Maya (Design): 👍 i'll update the spec and post mocks.
FormBot: automated note: created task ID #UI-3247 for "Settings form validation & delete flows" and assigned to @Tariq (Eng), @Maya (Design). due 2026-04-02.
Tariq (Eng): thanks — i'll start on the dialog and error-live region. ping me if mocks change.
Jordan (DesignOps): will follow up with localization team about "Required" translations and legend wording.
Sam (Accessibility): i'll draft an a11y test checklist and share in the thread.
Maya (Design): great, thanks all. small follow-up: should toast summary include direct links to each invalid field? e.g., "2 errors — View" that jumps to first invalid field?
Alex (PM): yes that would be useful. "View" should focus the summary or the first invalid field depending on context.
Tariq (Eng): ok will wire anchor focus to first invalid field id and ensure aria-describedby is set.
Maya (Design): cool — closing the loop once mocks up. :thumbsup:
